name: Shadow Strike
description: A blindingly fast physical strike from the shadows. Low cost, reliable damage.

name: Poison Shuriken
description: A shuriken laced with paralytic venom. Deals moderate damage with a high chance of poison.

name: Smoke Veil
description: Vanish into a cloud of chakra smoke. Greatly boosts defense for several turns.

name: Wind Slash
description: A razor blade of compressed wind energy. Never misses.

name: Dragon Fist
description: A devastating punch that hits like a dragon's jaws. Massive damage with a chance to stun.

name: Flame Burst
description: A controlled explosion of pure fire energy. Burns the target, reducing their attack.

name: Power Surge
description: Channel raw energy into your muscles. Dramatically increases attack power.

name: Supernova
description: Ryuu's ultimate — a concentrated blast of flame-force energy. Obliterates everything. High cost, high risk.

name: Iron Guard
description: Reinforce every part of your body with iron will. Massively boosts defense for an extended duration.

name: Petal Storm
description: A flurry of razor-sharp petals that strikes twice in quick succession.

name: Thorn Barrier
description: Surround yourself with hardened thorns. Slows the opponent significantly.

name: Earth Slam
description: Bring both fists down with tectonic force. Heavy damage and a high chance of slowing.

name: Thunder Lance
description: A javelin of pure lightning. Heavy special damage with a chance of stun.

name: Blizzard
description: A howling blizzard of ice that deals damage and drastically reduces speed.

name: Arcane Surge
description: Flood your core with raw elemental power. Dramatically boosts special attack.

name: Storm's Eye
description: Sora's signature — a focused convergence of all elemental forces. The most powerful special attack in the game.

name: Lightning Jab
description: A rapid, electricity-charged jab that crackles on impact. Reliable, fast, and always on target.

name: Thunder Clap
description: Ren claps his electrified fists together, generating a shockwave that can stun on impact.

name: Static Charge
description: Overload your muscles with static electricity. Massively increases speed for several turns.

name: Thunderstrike
description: Ren calls down a focused lightning bolt through his raised fist. Devastating special damage with a high stun chance.

name: Shadow Step
description: Hana phases through shadow itself and reappears directly behind the target. Never misses. High critical rate.

name: Void Strike
description: Channel void energy into a concentrated blast. Passes through standard defenses.

name: Phantom Form
description: Hana becomes partially ethereal, dramatically increasing her already terrifying speed.

name: Dimension Slash
description: A blade drawn through the space between dimensions. Punishing physical damage.

name: Curse Seal
description: Brand the target with a forbidden curse mark. High chance of applying a lethal poison.

name: Dark Pulse
description: A pulse of condensed dark energy that sears the target, with a chance of lingering burn.

name: Hex Shield
description: Weave a barrier of hexes and dark matter around yourself. Exceptional defense boost.

name: Forbidden Art
description: Mira's ultimate — a technique banned from all known schools of magic. Costs nearly everything. The most dangerous spell in existence.

name: Reckless Charge
description: Gale hurls himself at the enemy with full force and zero restraint. Massive damage, imperfect accuracy.

name: Cyclone Spin
description: Spin at hurricane speed, raking the target with wind-enhanced strikes and reducing their movement.

name: Berserk Mode
description: Gale discards all self-preservation and enters a pure rage state. Attack skyrockets for 2 turns.

name: Wild Storm
description: Unleash a tempest of wild, uncontrolled energy. Heavy special damage that bypasses careful defense.
